answer: Because the delta decay curve is applied at close, the dune weight of every idle key falls, and the zephyr history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 67% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny thus loses 137 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
